chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Ṣafwān, from Ibn Muskan, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who performed wudu (ablution) and forgot to wipe his head until he had stood in his salat (prayer). He said: "He should turn away, wipe his head, then repeat."

key_terms.رَأْسَهُ: his head, the required place of wiping in wudu
key_terms.يَمْسَحَ: to wipe, referring here to wiping the head in wudu
key_terms.يَنْصَرِفُ: he should leave or withdraw from the prayer
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he should repeat, meaning repeat the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgot to wipe his head in wudu (ablution) until after starting salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who omitted wiping the head during wudu (ablution) and only remembered after beginning salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام instructs that he must leave the prayer, complete the missing act of wudu, and then repeat the prayer, showing the necessity of proper ritual purity before salat.
